description_en: Rolls back a file system to the state of a specified historical snapshot
description_zh: 使文件系统回滚至某一历史快照的文件系统状态
name: ResetFileSystem

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Advanced Extreme NAS file system
parameters.help_zh: 指定的极速型NAS高级型文件系统ID
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the historical snapshot to which you want to roll back the specified file system
parameters.help_zh: 需要恢复到指定文件系统某一阶段的历史快照ID
parameters.name: snapshot_id
